check.stdout:
allowed:    false
reason:     no live tool-surface grant for user:visitor at harness tool broker: the agent's tool allow-list (hosted visitor: default deny)
capability: tool-surface
entryPoint: harness tool broker: the agent's tool allow-list
caller:     user:visitor
resource:   shell
revision:   -
entryPoints:
  agent-home:   the agent's own home (inherent, never granted to a visitor)
  tool-surface: harness tool broker: the agent's tool allow-list
  shared-path:  filesystem access outside the agent home
  org-context:  org shared folder reads
  isolation:    execution isolation mode (directory or container)

visibility.stdout:
caller:   user:visitor
hosted:   false
verified: true
decisions:
  target: user:other
  seeActors:
    allowed:    false
    reason:     no see-actors grant names user:other
    capability: see-actors
    caller:     user:visitor
    target:     user:other
  sendTo:
    allowed:    false
    reason:     no send-to grant names user:other
    capability: send-to
    caller:     user:visitor
    target:     user:other
visible: (none)

constructor.stderr: hyprial: principal uri must be a non-empty, unpadded string

scope.stderr: hyprial: see-actors scope must be one JSON value
